entries.5f593e348ed2380b: This division manufactures and sells barcode printers, full-color card printers, tags, labels, stickers, and others, by the company. Subsidiary Asahi Raberu handles part of the printing and manufacturing, part of the information equipment work is subcontracted to subsidiary Tsubasa Seisakusho, and the company sells some of these products to subsidiary Fenikkusu Denshi. Sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥4,440 million.
